items.title: 3.3 Artificial (insaan ka banaya hua) satellites (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3 with Figs. 3.11 to 3.14 and Example 3.4 (PDF 62-65).

blocks.text: Satellites woh cheezein hain jo Zameen ke gird taqreeban circular raste (orbit) mein ghoomti hain. Rockets unhen orbit mein pohanchate hain aur Zameen ki gravity unhen orbit mein rakhti hai. Neeche urne wale satellites ka acceleration Zameen ke centre (beech ka point) ki taraf 9.8 m s⁻² hota hai. Agar gravity na ho to satellite orbit ki tangent par seedha nikal jaye. Daire mein chalte satellite ka acceleration v²/r hai; Zameen ke gird circular orbit mein yeh centripetal acceleration gravity deti hai:
Yahan v orbital velocity aur R Zameen ka radius (6400 km) hai. Eq. 3.14 se:
Yeh woh kam se kam velocity hai jo satellite ko orbit mein rakhne ke liye zaroori hai; ise critical velocity kehte hain. Ek chakkar ka waqt (period) T:
Kitab period 5060 s likhti hai. Kitab hi ke number se 2 × 3.14 × 6400 ÷ 7.9 = 5088 s banta hai, yani taqreeban 85 min (84.8 min). Mota jawab “taqreeban 84-85 minute” theek hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.alt: Zameen ek circular orbit ke centre par. Ek bara elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) orbit ek taraf daire ko chhoota hai aur doosri taraf door tak jata hai. Ek raasta orbit se oopar ke qareeb nikal kar Zameen se door mur jata hai. Labels: 27,000 km/h circular orbit; 30,000 km/h elliptical orbit; 11 km/s ya 40,000 km/h escape (gravity se nikal jana).
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 62): Satellites ke orbits (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Satellite ki speed se us ka rasta badalta hai: taqreeban 27,000 km h⁻¹ par circular orbit, us se zyada (taqreeban 30,000 km h⁻¹) par elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) orbit, aur 11 km s⁻¹ (40,000 km h⁻¹) ya zyada par satellite Zameen ki gravity se nikal jata hai (escape).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Newton ne 300 saal pehle artificial satellites ki prediction (pehle se bata dena) kar di thi. Upar wali figure un ki mashhoor kitab “Principia Mathematica” se li gayi hai. Is ke mutabiq agar kisi kafi oonchi jagah se koi cheez ek khaas speed se horizontal phainki jaye to woh Zameen ke gird ghoomne lagegi.
blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: Lekin agar satellite Zameen ki surface (oopar wala hissa) se R se kahin zyada oonchai h par ho to yeh baat yaad rakhni hogi ke gravity ka acceleration Zameen ke centre se faasle ke square ke ulat (inverse square) kam hota hai (Fig. 3.11).

blocks.alt: Baen taraf radius R wali Zameen; centre se surface tak dohra teer R. Bohat door daen taraf satellite apne orbit (madaar) ki arc (daire ka tukra) par, orbit ke saath teer v. Zameen ki surface se satellite tak dohra teer h, aur Zameen ke neeche h >> R likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.11: Zameen ke radius R se kahin zyada unchai h par satellite (kitab ki Figure 3.11 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Satellite jitna ooncha, us ki zaroori speed utni kam aur ek chakkar ka waqt utna zyada.
Orbital Velocity

Fig. 3.12 mein ek satellite Zameen ke gird circular raste par ghoom raha hai. Satellite ka mass mₛ, orbital speed v, Zameen ka mass M aur orbit ka radius r hai. Satellite ko orbit mein rakhne ke liye centripetal force mₛv²/r chahiye, jo Zameen aur satellite ki gravitational attraction (kheenchne ka asar) deti hai. Dono ko barabar rakhein:

blocks.alt: Circular orbit ke centre par Zameen. Orbit par satellite ek line se Zameen ke centre se jura hai, jis par teer F Zameen ki taraf hai, aur satellite se ek teer orbit ke tangent ke saath hai. Labels: Earth, Satellite, F.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.12: Circular orbit mein Zameen ke gird ghoomta satellite (kitab ki Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text_alt: G mₛ M / r² = mₛ v² / r

blocks.text: Is se pata chalta hai ke orbit ke liye satellite ka apna mass important nahi. Zameen ke centre se faasle r par har satellite ki orbital speed Eq. 3.15 wali honi chahiye. Is se kam speed ho to satellite gir kar Zameen par wapas aa jayega.
Jaise hi aap mobile phone on karte hain, global positioning system (GPS) se aap ki location foran maloom ki ja sakti hai.
blocks.title: Tidbits
Example 3.4
blocks.problem: Ek satellite Zameen ki surface se 384,000 km faasle par circular orbit mein hai. Is ka ek chakkar kitne dinon mein poora hota hai? M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg aur R = 6400 km lein.
blocks.answer: T ≈ 28 din (yeh taqreeban Chand ka orbit hai).

blocks.text: Kitab v = 1.025 km s⁻¹ likhti hai; asal mein 1.025 × 10⁶ m² s⁻² square root ke andar ki value hai, aur us ka square root 1.01 km s⁻¹ banta hai. Kitab period ke formula mein R likhti hai magar number orbit radius r (390400 km) ka istemal karti hai; sahi T = 2πr/v. Sahi jawab taqreeban 28.0 din hai, 27.7 nahi.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: 1984 mein Bruce McCandless Hawaii ke oopar space shuttle se nikal kar space mein gaye aur Zameen ke pehle “insani satellite” ban gaye. Kitab ke mutabiq oonchai 100 km aur speed 29000 km h⁻¹ thi.
blocks.title: Tid-bits

blocks.text: Satellites mein weightlessness (wazan mehsoos na hona)

Jab rocket satellite ko us ke orbit mein pohancha deta hai to dekha gaya hai ke satellite ke andar har cheez weightless (wazan ke baghair) mehsoos hoti hai, kyunke satellite ek freely falling body (khud ba khud girti cheez) ki tarah Zameen ke centre ki taraf accelerate kar raha hota hai.
Lift (elevator) mein aap ka wazan sirf tab thora badalta mehsoos hota hai jab lift ki velocity badalti hai (chalne aur rukne waqt); jab velocity constant ho to nahi badalta.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: Mass M ka satellite lein jo radius r ke orbit mein Zameen ke gird ghoom raha hai. Satellite ki chhat se spring balance par latka mass m ka object do forces mehsoos karta hai: neeche ki taraf wazan mg, aur upar ki taraf spring ki tension, yani normal force F_N (Fig. 3.13). In dono ka resultant mass m ke liye zaroori centripetal force hai jo Zameen ke centre ki taraf hai:

blocks.alt: Centre wali Zameen, radius r ke dotted circular orbit ke andar. Orbit ke top par ek dabba (satellite) jis mein spring balance se mass latka hai. Dabbe par teer: F_N oopar, F_g = GmM/r² neeche Zameen ki taraf, aur orange teer v orbit ke saath. Saath mein latke mass ka free-body drawing: F_N = 0 N oopar aur F_g = GmM/r² neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.13: Zameen ke gird ghoomte satellite mein spring balance par latka mass (kitab ki Figure 3.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Satellite aur andar ka object dono ek hi acceleration g = v²/r se Zameen ki taraf “gir” rahe hain. Is liye spring ko object ko thamna nahi parta: spring balance F_N = 0 N dikhata hai, jabke object par gravity ki force GmM/r² ab bhi lag rahi hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Pani se bhari balti ko vertical daire mein tezi se ghumayein to sab se oopar ulti hone par bhi pani nahi girta. Kyun?
blocks.title: Can you tell? (Bata sakte hain?)

blocks.text: Oopar pani ko daire mein rakhne ke liye centripetal force mv²/r chahiye. Agar speed itni ho ke v²/r ≥ g, to pani ka wazan (aur balti ke bottom ka dhakka) mil kar yeh force poori karte hain; pani balti ke saath daire mein chalta hai, gir nahi sakta.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke satellite ko Zameen ke gird ghumane wali centripetal force Zameen aur satellite ki gravitational attraction hi deti hai:
Is liye Eq. 3.16(a) yeh ban jati hai:

Yani satellite ke andar object ko sahara dene wali force zero hai. Is liye satellite mein cheezein aur astronauts apparent weightlessness (wazan na hone ka sirf ehsaas) ki halat mein hote hain: wazan khatam nahi hota, sirf sahare ki force zero ho jati hai.
Artificial gravity (banawati gravity)

Gravity se khaali space mein koi force kisi ko spacecraft ki kisi deewar ki taraf nahi dhakelti. Agar spacecraft ko lambe arse tak orbit mein rehna ho to weightlessness (wazan mehsoos na hona) astronauts ke kaam par bura asar daal sakti hai. Iska hal: spacecraft mein artificial gravity paida ki jaye, taake crew taqreeban normal tareeqe se kaam kar sake. Iske liye spaceship ko apne axis ke gird ghumaya jata hai. Astronaut outer kinare (rim) ki taraf dabta hai aur spaceship ke ‘farsh’ par waise hi force lagata hai jaise Zameen par.
Fig. 3.14 jaisi shakal ka spacecraft lein jis ka outer radius R hai aur jo apne central axis par angular speed ω se ghoomta hai. Rim par kisi point ka centripetal acceleration a꜀:
Kitab yahan a꜀ ko “angular acceleration” kehti hai. a꜀ = Rω² rim ka centripetal acceleration hai; spaceship uniform (ek jaisi) ω se ghoom raha hai, is liye us ka angular acceleration zero hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.alt: Tirchha dekha gaya pahiye jaisa spaceship: chaurra hara outer kinara (rim) chaar spokes se beech ke hub se jura hai. Hub se guzarti dashed vertical (seedha khara) line rotation (ghoomna) ka axis hai, aur kinare ke gird laal mure teer pahiye ki rotation dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.14: Apne central axis ke gird ghoomta pahiye jaisa spaceship (kitab ki Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Pahiye jaisa spaceship apne axis par ghoomta hai. Rim par khara astronaut daire mein chal raha hai; farsh us par centre ki taraf force lagata hai, aur yahi dhakka use “wazan” jaisa mehsoos hota hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text_alt: Lekin ω = 2π/t (t = ek chakkar ka waqt)

blocks.text: Frequency f = 1/t hai, is liye:
Hum chahte hain ke rim ka centripetal acceleration Zameen ki gravity ke barabar ho, is liye:
Jab spaceship is frequency se ghoome to us ke rehne walon ko Zameen jaisi artificial gravity milti hai.
Ghoomte spaceship ki surface us cheez ko dhakelti hai jo us se chhoo rahi ho, aur yahi dhakka us cheez ko daire mein chalane wali centripetal force deta hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.alt: Drum (dhol) jaisa space station tirchha dekha gaya, saamne se khula hua taake andar nazar aaye. Beech se ek axis guzarta hai, aur axis ke gird laal mura teer station ki rotation (ghoomna) dikhata hai. Andar spokes axis wale hub ko rim (kinare) se jorte hain, rim ki andar wali surface par saaman rakha hai, aur neela teer F꜀ rim se axis ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 65): Ghoomta hua space station (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Station apne axis par ghoomta hai. Rim ki andar wali surface us par rakhi cheez ko axis (centre) ki taraf dhakelti hai; yahi dhakka F꜀ centripetal force hai jo cheez ko daire mein chalata hai, aur andar rehne walon ko yahi “wazan” jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

blocks.caption: Satellite ke formulas
rows: g = v²/R; v = √(gR) ≈ 7.9 km s⁻¹; T = 2πR/v ≈ 85 min
Radius r ka koi bhi orbit
v = √(GM/r); satellite ka mass important nahi
mv²/r = mg − F_N aur g = v²/r se F_N = 0

blocks.prompt: Ek satellite Zameen ki surface se 200 km oonchai par ghoomta hai; Zameen ka radius 6400 km le kar us ki orbital speed nikalein. 20 m radius ka space station 0.5 rad s⁻¹ se ghoomta hai; astronauts kitni artificial gravity mehsoos karte hain? Astronaut weightlessness kyun mehsoos karta hai?
blocks.explanation: r = 6400 + 200 = 6600 km = 6.6 × 10⁶ m. v = √(GM/r) = √(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 6.0 × 10²⁴ / 6.6 × 10⁶) ≈ 7.79 × 10³ m s⁻¹ ≈ 7.8 km s⁻¹. Space station: a꜀ = Rω² = 20 × (0.5)² = 5 m s⁻². Astronaut aur satellite dono ek hi acceleration g = v²/r se Zameen ki taraf freely gir rahe hain, is liye farsh ya spring ko sahara dene ki zaroorat nahi (F_N = 0): yahi apparent weightlessness hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Neecha orbit: g = v²/R, v = √(gR) ≈ 7.9 km s⁻¹ (critical velocity), T ≈ 85 min. Oonche orbit: kam speed, zyada period.
Orbital velocity v = √(GM/r): satellite ke mass par depend nahi karta. Example 3.4 (Chand jitna faasla): v ≈ 1.01 km s⁻¹, T ≈ 28 din.
Satellite mein F_N = 0: apparent weightlessness, kyunke sab kuch ek saath freely gir raha hai.
Artificial gravity: spaceship ko f = (1/2π)√(g/R) se ghumayein taake rim par a꜀ = Rω² = g ho.
